title.zh: ARK Launches Tokenized Venture Fund on Ethereum With $500 Minimum
title.en: ARK Launches Tokenized Venture Fund on Ethereum With $500 Minimum

current_state.zh: ARK Invest已通过Securitize在以太坊上将其13亿美元的ARK Venture Fund（ARKVX）代币化，该基金持有OpenAI、Anthropic和Stripe等仓位；美国零售投资者可以500美元最低门槛参与，流动性限于季度回购要约。
current_state.en: ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) on Ethereum via Securitize, with holdings including OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe; US retail investors can access it with a $500 minimum, with liquidity limited to quarterly repurchase offers.

updates.what_changed_en: Added details: the fund is the $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX), with holdings including OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe.
updates.current_state_zh: ARK Invest已通过Securitize在以太坊上将其13亿美元的ARK Venture Fund（ARKVX）代币化，该基金持有OpenAI、Anthropic和Stripe等仓位；美国零售投资者可以500美元最低门槛参与，流动性限于季度回购要约。
updates.current_state_en: ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) on Ethereum via Securitize, with holdings including OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe; US retail investors can access it with a $500 minimum, with liquidity limited to quarterly repurchase offers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ARK Invest is tokenizing its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX), which holds positions in OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe, onchain through Securitize on Ethereum.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ARK Invest is tokenizing its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX), which holds positions in OpenAI, Anthropic and Stripe, onchain through Securitize on Ethereum.
updates.background_zh: ARKVX 是 ARK 旗下的风投基金，该公司将其定位为让投资者参与创新型企业在私募与公开市场各阶段的发展。此次代币化延续了 ARK Invest 与 Securitize 围绕代币化投资产品已有的合作关系。
updates.background_en: ARKVX is ARK's venture fund, which the firm markets as offering investors access to innovative companies across their private and public market lifecycles. The tokenization follows an existing partnership between ARK Invest and Securitize around tokenized investment products.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息落在代币化现实世界资产（RWA）赛道：它把一只持有非上市科技公司股份的知名大规模基金纳入代币化产品池，可能提升市场对以太坊发行基础设施以及作为上市代币化服务商的 Securitize 的关注度。流动性安排是关键——认购通过 Securitize 进行，而赎回仍限于季度回购要约，因此代币化权益并不意味着具备连续性的二级市场流动性。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement sits in the tokenized real-world asset (RWA) segment: it adds a large, brand-name fund with private technology holdings to the pool of tokenized vehicles, which could draw attention to Ethereum-based issuance infrastructure and to Securitize as a listed tokenization provider. Liquidity terms matter here — subscriptions flow through Securitize while buybacks stay limited to quarterly repurchase offers, so tokenized interests do not imply continuous secondary-market liquidity.
